hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.cpp|*.hpp|*.h|*.cc|*.cxx|*.c) clang-format --style=file -i "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */build/*) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Editing files inside /build/ is not allowed — these are generated artifacts."}}\n';; esac; }
